classes.number_swapped_other_metric: A value is replaced by another trusted claim value for a different metric. numeric_issues compares Decimal values and ignores metric_id.
classes.wrong_subject: Only the player or team subject changes; every number is unchanged and trusted. The gate has no subject check.
classes.wrong_phase_or_window: Only home/road or playoffs/regular-season wording changes; every number stays trusted. Filters and season_type are reviewer-visible, not gate-checked.
classes.wins_losses_swapped: Both numbers are supplied claim values. The gate checks presence, not which value is wins and which is losses.
classes.per_game_total_confusion: The value is unchanged and trusted; only the per-game versus total wording changes. The gate does not inspect units.
classes.unsupported_causal_or_ranking: The added sentence contains no number tokens, so numeric_issues has nothing to check. Declared claim references are unchanged.
classes.coincident_percent: The percent token equals an integer value of an unrelated trusted claim or sample size, so _explained accepts it by value before percent conversion.
